verdicts.proof: Only one route, /success (router.dart:281-283), wrapped in MgBackGuard. The only entry points into it are payment_screen.dart:1376,1436, payment_ui_helpers.dart:97 and shell_fabs.dart:202, and both looks share them. BackButtonListener (payment_confirmation_screen.dart:284-292) and PopScope(canPop:false) (:293-301) wrap the MgV2.on branch at :303, so system Back and the swipe-back gesture call close() in v2 too. The v2 X button (MgStateScreen._close, mg_state_screen.dart:136-142, MgV2Back) and both dock buttons (confirmation_view_v2.dart:94,99,100) call the same close() (:279-282), which refreshes the reservations list and sends the customer to Reservations.

v2 has no data source of its own. It receives motoName/start/end/branchName/pickupTime/returnTime/noDetails from the same useDraft/noDetails logic (payment_confirmation_screen.dart:249-261, passed at :305-328). With noDetails, the summary is replaced by a skeleton or the failure banner (confirmation_view_v2.dart:96,122-131). paidTotal is passed only when the in-memory draft belongs to this booking (:330-332). This rule was added on this branch on top of 70a94933 and is a display rule in both looks.

The same _bkFailed flag (set at :158 and :230) is passed as loadFailed (:329). v2 shows an MgStateBanner with the signal-off icon, the heading fxConfirmLoadFail, the body fxConfirmLoadFailBody and an eoRetry button whose onTap is onRetry=_retryLoad (confirmation_view_v2.dart:122-130, screen :333, handler :96-99). While loading it shows a skeleton row (:131). The heading plus icon is at least as clear as the old emoji text line.

When docs are not missing, the v2 primary dock action is MgStateAction(successCta, onClose) (confirmation_view_v2.dart:97-99). onClose is the same close() (screen :334, :279-282). The old look does the same at :618-628.

The old amber card is at :540-572 (successSafetyTitle + successSafetyTips). v2 shows MgDisclosure with the label successSafetyTitle and initiallyExpanded:true (confirmation_view_v2.dart:107-115). The widget honours this flag (mg_disclosure.dart:47). The text v2UxPsSafetyTips (translations_ext_60_v2_ux_pay_shop_b.dart:10, cs) has the same three points, including the liability line. It is open by default, and the customer can fold it afterwards. The amber colour is gone (it is now a neutral card), but the warning heading and the open text stay.

lateGateDate is computed in the screen from the same lateGate (:264-278), startDate and the now<kioskReleaseAtUtc check (:317-321). It is the same condition as the old row at :485-495. v2 shows an info MgStateBanner with a clock icon and the heading v2UxPsKioskNote (confirmation_view_v2.dart:192-193). The cs text (ext_60_b:9) says release from 12:00 and how to change the pickup time, as ssLateGateNote does. The banner sits inside the pickup step, which needs start != null (:182,189); the condition already requires startDate, so nothing is lost.

returnTime is passed as null when selfServiceHidesReturnTime(branchType, returnMethod) is true (:313-316). This is the same helper and the same arguments as the old look (:470-481). v2 renders the row only when returnTime != null (confirmation_view_v2.dart:172).

pickup is passed as _hasPickupBlock ? _pickup : null (:310). _hasPickupBlock is defined at :106-107 and is the same decision as the old look at :451-460. In v2 the map/actions (PayPickupActionsV2) appear only when p != null (confirmation_view_v2.dart:191). For delivery, only the branch name is shown (:135, :163).

The same RPC check_booking_docs_status (:209-225) sets _DocsStatus.missing. It maps to PayDocsV2.missing (:322-326), and the reason goes through the same localizeServerReason (:327; the old look uses it at :794-795). The v2 docs step appears when docs != unknown (confirmation_view_v2.dart:188), the same condition as old :504. It shows an MgStateBanner in the warn tone, with an icon and a live region (mg_state_banner.dart:64,80), the heading docsMissingTitle and the reason + docsMissingBody (:198-205). The primary dock CTA switches to upload documents (:97-98). The back lock is the same as in G-298.

missing = docs == PayDocsV2.missing (confirmation_view_v2.dart:89). The primary action is uploadDocumentsCta -> onDocs (:97-98). onDocs (screen :335-338) does the same invalidate(reservationsProvider) and context.push(Routes.docs) as the old look (:609-615). Because it uses push, Back from Documents returns here, and the BackButtonListener isTopmostRoute check (:289) lets the Documents screen close first. The old pulsing orange button is now the v2 primary CTA, which loops on success screens (mg_state_screen.dart:52).

The secondary action is MgStateAction(successCta, onClose), only when missing (confirmation_view_v2.dart:100). It is rendered under the primary CTA (mg_state_screen.dart:206-226). The old look does the same at :629-638.

isChild (license N) sets verified + isChildBike without calling the RPC (:193-205). It maps to PayDocsV2.child (:325), and v2 shows an ok-tone banner docsChildBikeTitle/docsChildBikeBody (confirmation_view_v2.dart:207-211). These are the same texts as the old look at :785-791. In the fallback with no bookingId (:117-138), isChild also gives verified, so the child note shows in both looks.
